title.zh: OKX与ICE合资公司向SEC提交文件，规划代币化股票交易
title.en: OKX-ICE Joint Venture Files with SEC for Tokenized Stock Trading

current_state.zh: OKXICE是OKX与ICE合资推进的代币化股票交易场所，已向SEC提交文件，并成为SEC披露的三家拟按创新豁免机制运营代币化证券交易场所的通知机构之一，计划使用X Layer网络；SEC强调列入名单不代表已满足豁免条件。该场所拟支持62家公司/63个股票代码的7×24小时代币化股票交易，通过AMM与流动性池撮合，并允许发行方提出异议。目前已有22家发行方提出反对，包括富国银行、Arm Holdings和Intuit等；纳斯达克也选择排除自身股票。该场所尚未宣布上线日期，也并非SEC注册交易所。
current_state.en: OKXICE, the OKX-ICE joint venture tokenized stock venue, has filed with the SEC and is one of three firms the SEC disclosed as having notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its innovation exemption, planning to use the X Layer network; the SEC stressed that being listed does not confirm eligibility. The venue plans to support 24/7 trading of 62 companies/63 tickers via AMMs and liquidity pools, with issuers allowed to object. Twenty-two issuers have now objected, including Wells Fargo, Arm Holdings and Intuit; Nasdaq is also opting its own shares out. No launch date has been announced and the venue is not an SEC-registered exchange.

updates.title_zh: 【OKX 向 SEC 提交申请，拟推出代币化股票交易平台】
updates.title_en: 【OKX 向 SEC 提交申请，拟推出代币化股票交易平台】
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增细节：申请主体为 OKX 与 ICE 的合资企业 OKXICE LLC；拟首批覆盖 63 家 NYSE 上市公司；依据 SEC 上月临时豁免框架；发行方可在交易启动前 30 天内选择退出；代币须包含完整股息和投票权；平台上线时间取决于 30 天退出期结束及其他要求落实。
updates.what_changed_en: Added details: the filing entity is OKXICE LLC, the OKX–ICE joint venture; initial coverage is 63 NYSE-listed companies; the application relies on the SEC's interim exemptive framework for blockchain-based securities; issuers may opt out within 30 days before trading starts; tokens must carry full dividend and voting rights; platform launch depends on the 30-day opt-out period ending and other requirements being met.
updates.current_state_zh: OKX 通过其与 ICE 的合资企业 OKXICE LLC 向美国 SEC 提交申请，拟依据临时豁免框架提供首批 63 家 NYSE 上市公司的代币化股票交易；发行方可在启动前 30 天内选择退出，平台上线取决于退出期结束及其他要求落实情况。
updates.current_state_en: OKX, through its joint venture with ICE, OKXICE LLC, has filed with the US SEC to offer tokenized trading in 63 NYSE-listed stocks under the interim exemptive framework; issuers may opt out within 30 days before launch, and the platform launch depends on the opt-out period ending and other requirements being met.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: OKX, through its joint venture with NYSE parent ICE (OKXICE LLC), filed with the SEC to offer tokenized trading in 63 NYSE-listed stocks under the agency's interim exemptive framework for blockchain-based securities, with issuers able to opt out within 30 days and tokens required to carry full dividend and voting rights.
updates.detailed_summary_en: OKX, through its joint venture with NYSE parent ICE (OKXICE LLC), filed with the SEC to offer tokenized trading in 63 NYSE-listed stocks under the agency's interim exemptive framework for blockchain-based securities, with issuers able to opt out within 30 days and tokens required to carry full dividend and voting rights.
updates.background_zh: 此次申报之前，SEC 已发布命令，授予临时、有条件的豁免救济——即“创新豁免”——以推动部分代币化股票的链上交易，相关数字资产必须附带完整股东权益，包括分红权和投票权。在授予豁免时，SEC 就隔夜代币化股票交易可能如何影响流动性、定价以及传统市场的开盘、重开和收盘流程征求了公众意见。ICE 与 OKX 此前已组建合资公司 OKXICE，用于搭建连接传统金融与 7×24 小时数字资产市场的基础设施，安德鲁·库莫担任联席主席。
updates.background_en: The filing follows the SEC's order granting temporary, conditional exemptive relief — the "Innovation Exemption" — to facilitate onchain trading of certain tokenized stocks, under which digital assets must carry full shareholder benefits such as dividends and voting rights. In granting the exemption, the SEC sought public comment on how overnight tokenized-stock trading could affect liquidity, pricing and the opening, reopening and closing processes of conventional markets. ICE and OKX previously formed OKXICE as a joint venture to build infrastructure bridging traditional and 24/7 digital asset markets, with Andrew Cuomo as co-chair.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该提案指向一个以稳定币结算的平行交易场所，代币化美股可能在夜间和周末持续重新定价；这一传导渠道能否产生可用的价格信号，取决于自动做市商流动性池的深度。发行方的退出选择、流动性稀薄以及 SEC 可能设定的交易量上限，被列为决定该信号能在多大程度上反馈至传统定价的约束条件。
updates.market_impact_en: The proposal points to a parallel, stablecoin-settled venue where tokenized U.S. equities could keep repricing overnight and on weekends, a channel that would depend on the depth of AMM liquidity pools to produce a usable price signal before Wall Street reopens. Issuer opt-outs, thin liquidity and any SEC volume caps are the stated constraints that will determine how much that signal feeds back into conventional pricing.

updates.what_changed_zh:
据报道，纽约证券交易所母公司ICE与加密交易所OKX正筹划提供7×24小时的代币化股票交易，将传统交易所基础设施与加密原生连续交易市场结合。该合作被描述为仍处于早期阶段，尚未得到证实。

若该报道属实，这将把纽约证券交易所的运营方与加密原生交易平台连接起来，是传统交易所基础设施与数字资产市场的一次显著融合。其实际影响取决于相关计划能否走出目前报道中的早期阶段。

相关报道尚未得到ICE或OKX证实，也未披露上线时间、产品结构或监管批准等细节。ICE运营13家受监管交易所和6家清算所，并拥有数字资产托管业务ICE Digital Trust；OKX的前身是2013年成立的同名交易所Okcoin。
updates.what_changed_en:
ICE, the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange, and crypto exchange OKX are reportedly planning to offer 24/7 tokenized stock trading, combining traditional exchange infrastructure with crypto-native continuous markets. The reported collaboration is described as early-stage and has not been confirmed.

The reported tie-up would connect the operator of the NYSE with a crypto-native trading venue, a notable convergence of traditional exchange infrastructure and digital-asset markets. Any concrete effect depends on whether the plans advance beyond the reported early stage.

The reports remain unconfirmed by ICE or OKX, and no launch date, product structure or regulatory approvals were detailed. ICE operates 13 regulated exchanges and six clearing houses and owns ICE Digital Trust, a digital asset custody business; OKX began in 2013 as the exchange Okcoin.

updates.detailed_summary_en:
ICE, the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange, and crypto exchange OKX are reportedly planning to offer 24/7 tokenized stock trading, combining traditional exchange infrastructure with crypto-native continuous markets. The reported collaboration is described as early-stage and has not been confirmed.

The reported tie-up would connect the operator of the NYSE with a crypto-native trading venue, a notable convergence of traditional exchange infrastructure and digital-asset markets. Any concrete effect depends on whether the plans advance beyond the reported early stage.

The reports remain unconfirmed by ICE or OKX, and no launch date, product structure or regulatory approvals were detailed. ICE operates 13 regulated exchanges and six clearing houses and owns ICE Digital Trust, a digital asset custody business; OKX began in 2013 as the exchange Okcoin.
updates.background_zh: 代币化股票是基于区块链的代币，代表上市公司的股份，并旨在跟踪标的股票的价格；Kraken等平台已上线代币化股票和ETF。ICE拥有纽约证券交易所，以及多家期货交易所和清算所，并持有Bakkt和Polymarket的股份。OKX是一家大型加密货币交易所，产品包括钱包、NFT市场和股票交易服务。
updates.background_en: Tokenized stocks are blockchain-based tokens that represent shares of publicly traded companies and are designed to mirror the price of the underlying stock; venues such as Kraken already list tokenized stocks and ETFs. ICE owns the New York Stock Exchange as well as futures exchanges and clearing houses, and holds stakes in Bakkt and Polymarket. OKX is a major cryptocurrency exchange whose product line includes a wallet, an NFT marketplace and a stock-trading offering.
updates.market_impact_zh: 若该计划推进，代币化股票的订单流将同时经由传统交易所基础设施与加密交易平台，影响代币化股票与真实世界资产（RWA）板块、托管安排，以及7×24小时加密市场与传统交易时段之间的流动性分配。目前相关商谈尚未证实，也没有任何产品上线。
updates.market_impact_en: If it proceeds, the arrangement would route tokenized-equity order flow across both traditional exchange infrastructure and a crypto venue, touching the tokenized-stock and real-world-asset segment, custody arrangements and the split of liquidity between 24-hour crypto markets and conventional market hours. The reported talks are unconfirmed and no product has been launched.

updates.title_zh: SEC文件勾勒出OKX 63只代币化股票的24/7交易计划
updates.title_en: SEC Filing Outlines 24/7 Plan for 63 OKX Tokenized Stocks
updates.what_changed_zh:
OKX已向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交文件，说明在其平台上对63只代币化股票实行7×24小时全天候交易的框架。该文件与OKXICE实体相关，推进了该交易所布局代币化股票产品的进程。

这份文件是一家大型加密交易所切入代币化股票市场结构的实质性动作，而SEC工作人员已在2026年1月就联邦证券法如何适用于代币化证券发表过声明。

对该文件的报道称其对代币化股票交易设有限制，另有一个标题指出代币化证券交易场所不会挑战传统交易所。该文件本身并不构成对该计划的批准。
updates.what_changed_en: OKX has filed with the SEC to outline a 24/7 trading framework for 63 tokenized stocks on its platform, advancing its push into tokenized equity products.

updates.detailed_summary_en: OKX has filed with the SEC to outline a 24/7 trading framework for 63 tokenized stocks on its platform, advancing its push into tokenized equity products.
updates.background_zh: 2026年1月28日，SEC公司金融部、投资管理部以及交易与市场部的工作人员发布联合声明，说明联邦证券法如何适用于代币化证券，包括通过分布式账本技术记录的发行人发起的代币化证券。OKX成立于2013年，原名Okcoin，2017年更名，按日交易量计算运营着规模最大的加密货币交易所之一。
updates.background_en: On January 28, 2026, staff of the SEC's Divisions of Corporation Finance, Investment Management, and Trading and Markets issued a joint statement on how federal securities laws apply to tokenized securities, including issuer-sponsored tokenized securities recorded via distributed ledger technology. OKX, founded in 2013 as Okcoin and rebranded in 2017, operates one of the largest cryptocurrency exchanges by daily trading volume.
updates.market_impact_zh: 若该计划推进，股票敞口将通过加密交易场所撮合，使代币化股票产品、交易所交易量与托管安排与美国证券法对代币化股票的定性直接挂钩；SEC的这份文件正是这一传导路径的关键关口。
updates.market_impact_en: The plan, if it proceeds, would route equity exposure through a crypto trading venue, linking tokenized-equity products, exchange trading volumes and custody arrangements to how US securities law treats tokenized shares; the SEC filing is the gate through which that transmission runs.

updates.title_zh: 早间速览：九家蓝筹公司对代币化股票说不
updates.title_en: Morning Minute: Nine Blue Chip Companies Say No to Tokenized Stocks
updates.what_changed_zh: 九家蓝筹公司（Verizon、博通、联合健康、Cerebras、AppLovin、Applied Digital、Rocket Lab、CoreWeave、Applied Optoelectronics）已对OKXICE代币化股票交易场所提出反对，占其计划上市的63家公司的14%；纳斯达克也选择将其自身股票排除在外，理由是缺乏实时最优价格和合并行情报告。
updates.what_changed_en: Nine blue-chip issuers — Verizon, Broadcom, UnitedHealth, Cerebras, AppLovin, Applied Digital, Rocket Lab, CoreWeave and Applied Optoelectronics — have objected to their shares trading on OKXICE, equal to 14% of the 63 companies the venue planned to list; Nasdaq is also opting its own shares out, citing the lack of real-time best prices and consolidated tape reporting.
updates.current_state_zh: OKXICE是OKX与ICE合资推进的代币化股票交易场所，计划支持63只代币化股票并通过XLayer上的Uniswap v4池进行7×24小时交易。在Cerebras此前提出发行人反对后，现有九家蓝筹发行人提出反对，占计划名单的14%；纳斯达克也选择排除自身股票。该场所尚未宣布上线日期，且并非SEC注册交易所。
updates.current_state_en: OKXICE, the OKX-ICE joint venture tokenized stock venue, planned to support 63 tokenized stocks with 24/7 trading via Uniswap v4 pools on XLayer. After Cerebras' earlier issuer objection, nine blue-chip issuers have now objected, representing 14% of the planned roster, and Nasdaq is opting its own shares out. The venue has not announced a launch date and is not an SEC-registered exchange.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Nine blue-chip companies have objected to their shares being traded on OKX and ICE's tokenized stock venue OKXICE, marking the first significant issuer backlash against tokenized equities.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Nine blue-chip companies have objected to their shares being traded on OKX and ICE's tokenized stock venue OKXICE, marking the first significant issuer backlash against tokenized equities.

updates.title_zh: 微软、谷歌母公司等7家企业反对在OKX-ICE平台交易其代币化股票
updates.title_en: 微软、谷歌母公司等7家企业反对在OKX-ICE平台交易其代币化股票
updates.what_changed_zh: 微软、Alphabet、高盛、高通、卡特彼勒、麦当劳和西部数据这7家企业新提出反对，使已披露的反对发行方总数从9家增至16家（其中15家属于原62家公司名单，Cerebras不在最初名单内），OKXICE于10月19日更新了公开声明。
updates.what_changed_en: Seven more issuers — Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs, Qualcomm, Caterpillar, McDonald's and Western Digital — have objected, raising total disclosed objecting issuers from nine to 16 (15 of them on the original 62-company roster, with Cerebras outside that list), per the joint venture's 19 October updated public statement.
updates.current_state_zh: OKXICE是OKX与ICE合资推进的代币化股票交易场所，拟依据SEC五年期创新豁免框架支持62家公司/63个股票代码的7×24小时代币化股票交易，通过AMM与流动性池撮合，并允许发行方提出异议。目前16家发行方已提出反对（15家属原名单），纳斯达克也选择排除自身股票。该场所尚未宣布上线日期，也并非SEC注册交易所。
updates.current_state_en: OKXICE, the OKX-ICE joint venture tokenized stock venue, plans under the SEC's five-year Innovation Exemption to support 24/7 trading of 62 companies/63 tickers via AMMs and liquidity pools, with issuers allowed to object. Sixteen issuers have now objected (15 on the original roster), and Nasdaq is opting its own shares out. No launch date has been announced and the venue is not an SEC-registered exchange.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs and four other companies formally objected to the planned OKX-ICE platform trading tokenized versions of their shares, bringing the total number of objecting issuers to 16 and creating mounting friction for the SEC innovation-exemption-based tokenized US equity plan.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs and four other companies formally objected to the planned OKX-ICE platform trading tokenized versions of their shares, bringing the total number of objecting issuers to 16 and creating mounting friction for the SEC innovation-exemption-based tokenized US equity plan.

updates.title_zh: OKX-ICE联席主席：企业反对代币化股票计划是「正常反应」，符合预期
updates.title_en: OKX-ICE联席主席：企业反对代币化股票计划是「正常反应」，符合预期
updates.what_changed_zh: OKX-ICE联席主席Andrew Cuomo公开回应发行方反对，称16家企业反对其股票被代币化交易是“正常反应”且符合预期，并重申该模式允许企业自主选择加入或退出。
updates.what_changed_en: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo publicly responded to issuer opposition, calling the objections from 16 companies to their shares being tokenized a “normal reaction” and expected, while reiterating that the model lets issuers opt in or out.
updates.current_state_zh: OKXICE是OKX与ICE合资推进的代币化股票交易场所，拟依据SEC五年期创新豁免框架支持62家公司/63个股票代码的7×24小时代币化股票交易，通过AMM与流动性池撮合，并允许发行方提出异议。目前16家发行方已提出反对（15家属原名单），纳斯达克也选择排除自身股票；OKX-ICE联席主席Andrew Cuomo称这一反对是正常且符合预期的反应，并强调企业可自主选择加入或退出。该场所尚未宣布上线日期，也并非SEC注册交易所。
updates.current_state_en: OKXICE, the OKX-ICE joint venture tokenized stock venue, plans under the SEC's five-year Innovation Exemption to support 24/7 trading of 62 companies/63 tickers via AMMs and liquidity pools, with issuers allowed to object. Sixteen issuers have now objected (15 on the original roster), and Nasdaq is opting its own shares out. OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo said the opposition is a normal and expected reaction and stressed that issuers can opt in or out. No launch date has been announced and the venue is not an SEC-registered exchange.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo said issuer opposition to tokenized stock trading is a normal and expected reaction, after 16 companies including Microsoft, Alphabet and Goldman Sachs objected to their shares being tokenized on the planned OKX-ICE platform.
updates.detailed_summary_en: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo said issuer opposition to tokenized stock trading is a normal and expected reaction, after 16 companies including Microsoft, Alphabet and Goldman Sachs objected to their shares being tokenized on the planned OKX-ICE platform.

updates.title_zh: 【美 SEC 披露三家拟按新豁免机制运营代币化证券交易场所的机构】
updates.title_en: 【美 SEC 披露三家拟按新豁免机制运营代币化证券交易场所的机构】
updates.what_changed_zh: SEC公开披露已有三家公司通知其计划按新创新豁免机制运营代币化证券交易场所，OKXICE为其中之一，并计划使用OKX旗下X Layer网络；SEC同时强调，列入名单不代表相关公司已满足豁免条件。
updates.what_changed_en: The SEC publicly disclosed that three firms have notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its new innovation exemption, including OKXICE, which plans to use OKX's X Layer network; the SEC cautioned that being listed does not confirm eligibility for the exemption.
updates.current_state_zh: OKXICE是OKX与ICE合资推进的代币化股票交易场所，已向SEC提交文件，并成为SEC披露的三家拟按创新豁免机制运营代币化证券交易场所的通知机构之一，计划使用X Layer网络；SEC强调列入名单不代表已满足豁免条件。该场所拟支持62家公司/63个股票代码的7×24小时代币化股票交易，通过AMM与流动性池撮合，并允许发行方提出异议。目前16家发行方已提出反对，纳斯达克也选择排除自身股票；OKX-ICE联席主席Andrew Cuomo称这一反对是正常且符合预期的反应。该场所尚未宣布上线日期，也并非SEC注册交易所。
updates.current_state_en: OKXICE, the OKX-ICE joint venture tokenized stock venue, has filed with the SEC and is one of three firms the SEC disclosed as having notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its innovation exemption, planning to use the X Layer network; the SEC stressed that being listed does not confirm eligibility. The venue plans to support 24/7 trading of 62 companies/63 tickers via AMMs and liquidity pools, with issuers allowed to object. Sixteen issuers have objected, and Nasdaq is opting its own shares out; OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo called the opposition normal and expected. No launch date has been announced and the venue is not an SEC-registered exchange.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The SEC disclosed that three firms — TSV LLC on Canton Network, the OKX–ICE joint venture OKXICE on X Layer, and Kephas Corp. on Kronos X — have notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its new innovation exemption, while cautioning that listing does not confirm eligibility.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The SEC disclosed that three firms — TSV LLC on Canton Network, the OKX–ICE joint venture OKXICE on X Layer, and Kephas Corp. on Kronos X — have notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its new innovation exemption, while cautioning that listing does not confirm eligibility.

updates.title_zh: 富国银行和Arm等22家企业反对在OKXICE平台交易其代币化股票
updates.title_en: 富国银行和Arm等22家企业反对在OKXICE平台交易其代币化股票
updates.what_changed_zh: 据路透社看到的一份监管文件，包括富国银行、Arm Holdings和Intuit在内的另外六家公司反对其股票在OKXICE平台被代币化，使已披露的反对发行方总数从16家增至22家；文件未说明这些公司反对的具体原因。
updates.what_changed_en: A regulatory filing seen by Reuters showed six more companies — including Wells Fargo, Arm Holdings and Intuit — will not allow their shares to be tokenized on the OKXICE platform, raising the total disclosed objecting issuers from 16 to 22; the filing did not state their specific reasons.
updates.current_state_zh: OKXICE是OKX与ICE合资推进的代币化股票交易场所，已向SEC提交文件，并成为SEC披露的三家拟按创新豁免机制运营代币化证券交易场所的通知机构之一，计划使用X Layer网络；SEC强调列入名单不代表已满足豁免条件。该场所拟支持62家公司/63个股票代码的7×24小时代币化股票交易，通过AMM与流动性池撮合，并允许发行方提出异议。目前已有22家发行方提出反对，包括富国银行、Arm Holdings和Intuit等；纳斯达克也选择排除自身股票。该场所尚未宣布上线日期，也并非SEC注册交易所。
updates.current_state_en: OKXICE, the OKX-ICE joint venture tokenized stock venue, has filed with the SEC and is one of three firms the SEC disclosed as having notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its innovation exemption, planning to use the X Layer network; the SEC stressed that being listed does not confirm eligibility. The venue plans to support 24/7 trading of 62 companies/63 tickers via AMMs and liquidity pools, with issuers allowed to object. Twenty-two issuers have now objected, including Wells Fargo, Arm Holdings and Intuit; Nasdaq is also opting its own shares out. No launch date has been announced and the venue is not an SEC-registered exchange.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Twenty-two companies including Wells Fargo, Arm Holdings and Intuit have told regulators they will not allow their shares to be tokenized on the joint OKX-ICE trading platform, highlighting growing corporate resistance to equity tokenization.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Twenty-two companies including Wells Fargo, Arm Holdings and Intuit have told regulators they will not allow their shares to be tokenized on the joint OKX-ICE trading platform, highlighting growing corporate resistance to equity tokenization.
